name: Vashti
summary: Vashti was the queen of King Ahasuerus. When she would not come at his command, the king took away her royal place and later made Esther queen instead.

key_moments.title: Refuses to Come to the King
key_moments.description: While Queen Vashti held a women's feast, the king, merry with wine, sent for her to come wearing the royal crown so the people could see her beauty. Vashti would not come, and the king burned with anger.

key_moments.title: Removed as Queen
key_moments.description: Memucan said Vashti had wronged not only the king but all the people, for wives everywhere would look down on their husbands. So a royal law was given that Vashti must never again appear before the king, and her place would go to another.
